testResults.question: Why would a React Native FlatList become slow and how do you fix it?
testResults.before: FAILED — used numbered lists (1. 2. 3.) and bold bullets (- **X**:)
testResults.after: 10/10 — pure prose, no numbered lists, no bold bullets, flowing paragraphs with root cause + fix
testResults.answer: A React Native FlatList may become slow primarily due to inefficient rendering practices. The most common root cause is that the list items are not properly optimized, which results in unnecessary re-renders. Specifically, if the items are not memoized, each state change in the parent component triggers a full re-render of every item in the list...

testResults.name: Decision/Opinion
testResults.question: Should we use Supabase RLS or application-level auth for our investor API?
testResults.answer: I would recommend using Supabase Row-Level Security (RLS) for our investor API. The main advantage is that RLS enforces security at the database level, ensuring that each query respects access policies regardless of the source...
